'''John Contreras''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 11th, 8 (+9) at [[2001 Texas State Championship]] on 31 March 2001, according to Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2006">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-2001-texas-states-directors-reportd2006/ 2001-texas-states-directors-report], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 2 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-2001-texas-states-directors-reportd2006/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
